sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Sales should hear about the paused account before {CLIENT} calls them.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'll message their account manager.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thanks, {S2|owner} lets the account manager know by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Should we warn sales about pausing {CLIENT}?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Definitely, before the customer calls them.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Can {S2|owner} tell the account manager by {DATE_REL|deadline}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The laptops need to be ordered in two batches.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I can place the first order.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great, {S2|owner} orders the first batch by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Who places the laptop order?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S2|owner}, please order the first batch by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sure.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We need a short guide for the corporate cards.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: People will have lots of questions.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S2|owner}, can you write a one-page guide by {DATE_ABS|deadline}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Right, {DATE_ABS}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes, no problem.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Employees will ask loads of questions about the cards.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: A short guide would help.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So {S2|owner} writes a one-page card guide by {DATE_ABS|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Wait, {DATE_ABS} already?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay.
